title: The concrete constant-unit comparison is the native single-degree unit
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and any scheme T, the hom of constantUnit A T from the ordinary finite constant coefficient complex to the derived tensor unit [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data] equals the hom of singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat A) T.

proof.text: The oplax monoidal unit of constantSheaf is presheafToSheaf.map(identity) followed by identity, hence identity. Its inverse monoidal unit iso is this map. Apply preservation of identity by the single-degree functor and cancel the leading identity in constantUnit.

proof_origin.place: Proved constant-unit normalization used in the first-coordinate tail.

from.place: The constant-object unit normalization in the first triangle.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic identity preservation supplies the elementary normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem constantUnit_hom
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (constantUnit A T).hom = (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).hom
